name: Dragontongue
body:
[Source: GB19]

DETAIL

This drug bonds to the language center of the brain, granting psychic confidence and an intuitive understanding of languages.

Type injury (injected); Addiction minor, Fortitude DC 16; Price 260 gp

Effect 2 hours; +2 alchemical bonus to Linguistics checks for 2 hours. During this time, gain comprehend languages and scare as spell-like abilities (CL 6th), each usable once.

DAMAGE

1d3 Dexterity damage
